newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu to buy 40% stake in Portugal telecom firm.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu to buy 40% stake in Portugal telecom firm.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Friday that it will buy a 40 percent stake in a Portuguese telecom equipment marketing company by the end of this month and boost its holdings in the firm to 100 percent by 1999.

Fujitsu's British subsidiary Fujitsu Telecommunications Europe Ltd will buy a 40 percent stake in Lisbon-based Elotecnico Electronica e Telecomunicacoes SA for a total of 650 million yen, a company spokesman said.
This will be Fujitsu's first purchase of a company based in the European continent.

The Portuguese firm, which currently has annual sales of about two billion yen, will function as a manufacturer and marketing firm of Fujitsu telecom equipment targeted at the European Union (EU) market, he said.

Fujitsu hopes that by purchasing an interest in the Portuguese firm, which has strong ties to the nation's largest carrier Portugal Telecom, it will be able to increase business with Portugal Telecom.
Elotecnico Electronica e Telecomunicacoes SA is engaged in various businesses including the sale of relay stations for mobile phone system and the installation of telephones.
The firm will receive technical assistance from Fujitsu on optical data transmission and digital telecommunications cable technology.
